correctness.rationale: PASS: The exact first-reset survival telescopes to s_i(n)=((i+1)/(i+n+1))^beta. The renewed zero-start law P_0(X_m=k)=(k+1)^(-beta)u_(m-k), together with decreasing renewal masses u_m down to 1/zeta(beta), gives the exact zero-start tail distance and a uniform delayed-renewal upper bound. For any fixed linear horizon n<=Ti, the explicit criterion beta/((beta-1)(i+1))*sum_{r<=N}r^(1-beta)<s_i(N) is eventually satisfied, forcing every restarted state to lie below stationary mass while {i+n} alone lies above. This yields the exact total variation and ceiling mixing time. The beta>1 one-collapse J1 limit follows from the first-reset Pareto time and O(i^(1-beta)) union bound on subsequent large excursions. Independent exact-rational transition recursions with zeta integral-test brackets corroborated 1,632 state-discrepancy inequalities; they do not prove universal quantifiers.
